done_when: on a domain without a month field, a single month filter becomes the answer's period whatever partial period the model also sent; the open, last-1-month and end-only shapes seen live all reach the plant picker, and only a conflicting explicit from-to period is still rejected; leaves per shape

findings.body: `isPartialWindow` treats any window containing `last` as partial even when both `from` and `to` are also present. The tool schema (lines 173–182) and `parseTimeWindow` (lines 608–624) allow all three fields together, so a model response such as `last: 1, from: "2026-06-01", to: "2026-06-30"` alongside a July month filter is silently rewritten to July instead of rejecting the conflicting explicit from-to period. The `last` condition is unnecessary for genuine relative windows because those already lack `from` or `to`; remove it or reject mixed relative/explicit windows. The existing conflict test does not cover this accepted shape.
